summary: A quiet, friendly second week — 19 messages across only three active days (8/8, 8/10, 8/12), all of it between Alanna, Ollie and Derrek. Alanna raised no complaints and chased nothing herself — her tone stayed warm throughout ('Thanks so much', 'Appreciate it'). First invoice lands 8/15, one day after this window, with no pre-invoice contact from Stephski since 8/4.
